book.name: Maluko
book.title: Mbuli Inogile ya Yesu Kilisito yandikigwe na Maluko

content: Yesu kowagwaa ndiya wanhu elufu nne
Hazibitile siku nyingi lunhu luyagwe lukulu lwa wanhu luiting'hana. Wanhu viwakalile wabule kinhu chochose chakuja Yesu kawakema wanahina zake kawalongela,
“Niye nowonela bazi wanhu wano, kwavija wakala na niye kwa siku ndatu na wabule kinhu chakuja.
Nahawalongela wabwele ukayao na nzala, osinduka mnzila, kwavija wanhu wayagwe walawa kutali.”
Wanahina zake wamuuza, “Hano hatwili twa kuluwala, toipata kwahi ndiya ya kuwagwaa wanhu wose wano?”
Yesu kawauza, “Mna magate mangapi?” Wamwidika, “Tuna magate saba.”
Yesu kalulongela lunhu luja lwa wanhu lukale hasi. Abaho kasola gamagate saba, kamgwaa nhogolwa Imulungu, kagabanzula kawagwaa wanahina zake wawagolele wanhu, na wanahina zake watenda vivo.
Vivija wakala na visomba kidogo. Yesu kamgwaa nhogolwa Imulungu, vivija kawalongela wanahina zake wawagolele wanhu.
Wanhu waja na kwiguta. Abaho wanahina zake wadondola vija visigale na kumemeza vigelo saba.
Wambigalo waiyeka wadile wakala elufu nne. Abaho Yesu kawalaga,
bahaja Yesu na wanahina zake wakwela mwiingalawa, wachola mwiisi ya Dalimanuta.
Mafalisayo olonda vilaguso
Mafalisayo wayagwe wamcholela Yesu wasonga kuibamilila nayo, walonda kumgeza wampula yatende kilaguso kulawa kuulanga.
Lakini Yesu kona usungu, kalonga, “Habali wanhu wa lukolo luno lwa sambi molonda vilaguso? Nowalongeleni ukweli, kuduhu kilaguso chonda mugoleligwe!”
Yesu kawaleka, kakwela mwiingalawa kaloka mwambu uyagwe wa dilamba.
Usasu wa Mafalisayo na Helode
Wanahina zake wakala waisemwile kusola magate, wakala na gate dimoja diiyeka mwiingalawa.
Yesu kawazuma wanahina zake kawalongela, “Muiteganye na hamila ya Mafalisayo na hamila ya Helode.”
Wanahina zake wasonga kuinyong'onyela, “Ino kolonga vino kwavija twabule magate.”
Yesu kakijuwa kiwakalile olonga, kawauza, “Habali moilongela mbuli ya magate? Vino mung'hali hamujuwile? Habali mizoyo yenu midala?
Muna meso lakini hamulola, muna magwiti lakini hamuhulika? Vino hamukumbuka bule?
Vinibanzule magate matano na kuwagwaa wanhu elufu tano? Vino mmemeza vigelo vingapi kwa avo visigale?” Wamwidika, “Tumemeza vigelo longo na vibili.”
Kawauza kabili, “Vivija vinibanzule gaja magate saba na kuwagwaa wanhu elufu nne, vino mmemeza vigelo vingapi kwa avo visigale?” Wamwidika, “Tumemeza vigelo saba.”
Abaho kawauza, “Mung'hali hamnavijuwa?”
Yesu komuhonya msuwameso ako Betisaida
Yesu na wanahina zake viwavikile Betisaida, wanhu wayagwe wamgalila Yesu munhu yakalile msuwameso, wampula yamkwase.
Yesu kamgoga mkono munhu ayo, kamulava kunze ya kijiji kija. Abaho kamtemela mate mgameso, kamwikila makono, kamuuza, “Vino kokona choni?”
Munhu ija kalola, kalonga, “Nowona wanhu, lakini waigala na mibiki itembela.”
Yesu kamwikila makono kabili mgameso. Munhu ayo kabunhula meso na meso gake galola, nayo kadaha kulola goya vinhu vose.
Yesu kamulongela munhu ayo yachole ukae kumwake, kamzuma, “Sikuyabweleganye mna ikijiji.”
Petulo kolonga Yesu ayo Mkombola
Abaho Yesu na wanahina zake wachola kuna ivijiji va Kaisalia ya Filipi, mnzila Yesu kawauza wanahina zake, “Nongeleni wanhu olonga niye na nani?”
Wamwidika, “Wanhu wayagwe olonga gweye kwa Yohana Mbatizaji, wanhu wayagwe olonga gweye kwa Eliya, kuno wayagwe olonga gweye kwa imoja wa watula ndagu wa Imulungu.”
Yesu kawauza, “Na mweye molonga niye na nani?” Petulo kamwidika, “Gweye kwa Kilisito Mkombola.”
Abaho Yesu kawagomesa wanahina zake, “Sikumumulongele munhu yoyose mbuli zangu.”
Yesu kolonga mbuli ya madununzo na ifa yake

Abaho Yesu kasonga kuwafundiza wanahina zake, “Mwana wa Munhu kolondigwa yadununzigwe ng'hani na kulemigwa na wavele na wakulu wa walava nhosa na wafundiza Malagizo ga Musa. Kokomigwa na siku da kadatu kozilibuka.”
Yesu kawalongela fulu ipile, avo Petulo kamgala Yesu kumgwazo kasonga kumkomhokela.
Lakini Yesu kahinduka kawalola wanahina zake, kamkomhokela Petulo, “Segela kumwangu Mwenembago! Kwavija hugesa mbuli za Imulungu lakini kogesa mbuli za kiunhu!”
Abaho Yesu kalukema lunhu lwa wanhu na wanahina zake kawalongela, “Munhu yoyose yahalonda kunikweleleza, yaileme mwenyego na kuidikwa msalaba wake yanikweleleze.
Kwavija munhu yoyose yahalonda kuukombola ugima wake kowagiza, na munhu yoyose yowagiza ugima wake mbuli ya niye na kwa Mbuli Inogile koukombola.
Vino munhu kopata choni kamba yahaipata isi yose na kuwagiza ugima wake?
Kuduhu kinhu chonda yalave yaubweze ugima wake.

Munhu yoyose yonyonela kinyala niye na mafundizo gangu mna ulukolo lwa sambi lulekile kumjuwa Imulungu na kutenda gehile, Mwana wa Munhu nayo komonela kinyala munhu ayo yaheza muukulu wa Tatake na wasenga zake wang'alile wa kuulanga.”
